OnePlus Goodix fingerprint sensor

Required properties:
- compatible: Must be "goodix,fingerprint".
- interrupt-parent: GPIO interrupt controller.
- fp-gpio-irq: GPIO connected to the sensor interrupt.
- fp-gpio-reset: GPIO connected to the sensor reset input.
- fp-gpio-enable: GPIO used by the fp_en_init and fp_dis_init states.
- fp-gpio-turn-on: GPIO used to turn on the sensor.
- pinctrl-names: Must include "fp_en_init", "fp_dis_init", and
  "fp_enable".
- pinctrl-0: Initial enable and interrupt pin states.
- pinctrl-1: Initial disable pin state.
- pinctrl-2: Sensor turn-on pin state.

The OnePlus Dumpling node also carries the oem,dumpling flag used to select
its pinctrl sequence.
